name: Agent Lovesdick
source:
After rumors about members of Rebel Nymes Guild having sex among them, Mr. Trumpson, the biggest businessman of Plymouth Town realizes that this is an opportunity to take over the most respectful position in the city.

To prove theses acts which are unacceptable by local elders, Lovesdick is hired by the businessman and his duty is to collect pieces of evidence capable of closing the Guild. Although his work seemed easy, what he didn't expect was that watching people having sex would turn him on.

Find out in this gay adventure!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在关于反叛尼姆斯公会成员与他们发生性关系的传言之后，普利茅斯镇最大的商人特朗普森先生意识到这是一个接管该市最受尊敬的职位的机会。

为了证明这些当地长老无法接受的行为，洛夫迪克受雇于商人，他的职责是收集能够关闭公会的证据。虽然他的工作看起来很轻松，但他没想到的是，看着人们做爱会让他兴奋起来。

在这个同性恋冒险中找出答案！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054470/]Steam[/url]]
